summary: Tested corrected Payment Gateway flow in Cotizador. All features verified: 1) Persona Jurídica auto-loads when selecting Payment Gateway (from /api/pg-defaults), 2) Fixed 'Fijo' badge prevents removal, 3) Bank-first selection flow with Concepto filtered by bank, 4) 'Generar Tabla de Recurrentes' button shows full table with 15 ranges, 5) PDF generation for PG quotes. Backend: 7/7 tests passed. Frontend: All features verified via Playwright.

ui_bugs.priority: LOW - cosmetic only, does not affect functionality

auto_load_persona_juridica.details: When selecting Payment Gateway type (and completing header), 'Persona Jurídica' is automatically loaded into pgSetupItems with cost from pg-defaults

fijo_badge_non_removable.details: 'Fijo' badge visible on Persona Jurídica row, no trash icon present - item cannot be removed

bank_first_selection.details: Campo 1 (Banco) must be selected first. Concepto shows 'Seleccione banco primero' until bank is selected

filtered_concepto_by_bank.details: After selecting a bank (e.g., 'Banco de Venezuela'), Concepto dropdown shows only that bank's products (5 options filtered)

generar_tabla_recurrentes_button.details: Button 'Generar Tabla de Recurrentes' appears after adding medios de pago, replaces range selector approach

full_recurring_table_15_ranges.details: Clicking button shows full table with all 15 transaction ranges, columns 'Total $ Base' and 'Precio Tope por Rango'

guardar_cotizacion_pg_button.details: 'Guardar Cotización PG' button present after setup items added

pg_quote_creation_with_pdf.details: PG quote created successfully with pg_setup_items stored and PDF generated in /app/backend/uploads/

vpos_mpos_regression.details: VPOS/MPOS flow still works normally - Modelo de Precios, Cajas, Bancos, Pinpad, Entidad Patrocinadora fields all visible

test_classes: TestPGDefaultsEndpoint (1 test) - verifies /api/pg-defaults returns Persona Jurídica with concepto and costo
TestBanksWithProducts (1 test) - verifies banks have products for filtering
TestPGQuoteCreation (2 tests) - verifies PG quote creation and PDF generation
TestPGRecurringCostsTable (2 tests) - verifies 15 ranges and data for 1-11 products
TestVPOSMPOSRegression (1 test) - verifies VPOS/MPOS still works

features_tested: Payment Gateway type selection auto-loads Persona Jurídica
Fixed 'Fijo' badge present, no trash icon for fixed item
Bank selector (Campo 1) must be selected before Concepto (Campo 2)
Concepto dropdown filtered by selected bank (e.g., Banco de Venezuela shows 5 products)
Add medio de pago button adds item to setup table
Generar Tabla de Recurrentes button generates full 15-range table
Table shows Total $ Base and Precio Tope por Rango columns

critical_code_review_comments: React hydration warning in Quotes table (span inside tbody) - LOW priority, cosmetic issue from Emergent's Visual Editor wrapper
seed_data_creation: PG quotes created during testing with pg_setup_items and PDF
context_for_next_testing_agent: Payment Gateway corrected flow fully verified. Key implementation details: 1) onValueChange handler for quote_type (line 2519 in Quotes.jsx) auto-inits pgSetupItems with Persona Jurídica from pgDefaults when value === 'GATEWAY'; 2) handlePgBankChange filters products for selected bank; 3) generatePgRecurringTable generates full table via getPgFullRecurringTable(); 4) handleSubmitPGQuote saves quote with setup items and recurring data. All backend APIs working: /api/pg-defaults, /api/pg-recurring-costs, /api/quotes/create-with-pdf.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - All features working correctly as designed
